cc:Work.dc:title: Endometrial expression across cohorts
cc:Work.dc:description: Case-minus-control relative-expression ranks in Finland and Rome for five genes and five pathways. ABO is higher in both cohorts. The other nine estimates reverse direction, including all five pathways. Each cohort uses its own array reference.
